title: Jade Biosciences Announces Appointment of Mark Eisner, M.D., M.P.H., to Board of Directors
author: Na
description: Jade Biosciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: JBIO) announced the appointment of Dr. Mark Eisner, M.D., M.P.H., to its Board of Directors effective June 25, 2026. Dr. Eisner brings over 25 years of leadership experience in clinical development and immunology, including previous roles as Chief Medical Officer at Vir Biotechnology, Sonoma Biotherapeutics, and FibroGen, as well as 11 years at Genentech/Roche. The appointment is expected to strengthen Jade's advancement of its pipeline of antibody-based therapies for autoimmune diseases.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced executive with 25+ years in biopharmaceutical development and a strong track record at major companies (Genentech/Roche, Vir Biotechnology) strengthens the company's leadership and credibility. This signals confidence in the company's pipeline advancement and increases the likelihood of successful clinical development and regulatory approval for its autoimmune disease therapies.

title: Stock Market Today: S&P 500, Dow, Nasdaq Futures Fall As House Challenges Trump's Military Authority— Broadcom, CrowdStrike In Focus (UPDATED)
author: Rishabh Mishra
description: U.S. stock futures showed mixed performance on Thursday with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 declining while the Dow Jones gained. Key movers included CrowdStrike surging on a 4-for-1 stock split announcement, Broadcom falling despite beating earnings estimates, and PVH plummeting after disappointing guidance. The House passed a war powers resolution challenging Trump's military authority in a rare bipartisan vote. BlackRock maintains an optimistic outlook on U.S. equities driven by AI sector strength and resilient corporate earnings.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock surged 9.98% in premarket after beating earnings estimates and announcing a 4-for-1 stock split. Maintains strong price trends across all timeframes.
Stock dropped 12.32% despite beating adjusted earnings estimates ($2.44 vs $2.40 expected) because Q2 revenue of $22.19 billion fell slightly short of Wall Street expectations of $22.27 billion.
Stock was essentially flat at 0.17% higher ahead of earnings announcement. Maintains weak price trends but has a solid value score.
Stock plummeted 20.54% after releasing Q3 earnings and issuing Q4 EPS guidance below analyst estimates, indicating disappointing forward outlook.
Stock dropped 6.20% following announcement of a public offering of 10 million shares at $15.00 per share, which typically dilutes existing shareholders.
Down 0.41% in premarket trading, reflecting broader S&P 500 weakness with futures declining 0.37%.
Down 0.97% in premarket trading, tracking the Nasdaq 100 which declined 0.85% as technology stocks faced selling pressure.

title: Jade Biosciences Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock
author: Na
description: Jade Biosciences (Nasdaq: JBIO), a clinical-stage biotech company focused on autoimmune diseases, announced the pricing of a public offering of 10 million shares at $15.00 per share, raising $150 million in gross proceeds. The offering is expected to close on June 5, 2026, with net proceeds to be used for clinical trials, preclinical studies, manufacturing, and R&D activities. Jefferies, TD Cowen, and UBS Investment Bank are serving as joint book-running managers.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully priced a substantial $150 million public offering, demonstrating investor confidence and providing significant capital to advance its clinical pipeline for autoimmune disease therapies. The funding will support advancement of lead candidate JADE101 and other pipeline programs.

title: Jade Biosciences Announces Positive Interim Phase 1 Results for JADE101 Demonstrating Potential Best-in-Class Profile and Every-12-Week Dosing in IgA Nephropathy
author: Jade Biosciences
description: Jade Biosciences reported positive interim Phase 1 results for JADE101, an anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody for IgA nephropathy treatment. The drug demonstrated ~70% IgA reductions sustained at 12 weeks with a favorable safety profile and potential for every-12-week dosing. Phase 2 trials are underway with Phase 3 expected to initiate in H1 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company announced positive interim Phase 1 data showing strong efficacy (70% IgA reductions), favorable safety profile, convenient dosing (every 12 weeks), and advancement to Phase 2 trials with Phase 3 planned for H1 2027. The drug demonstrates potentially best-in-class characteristics compared to competitors, supporting clinical and commercial progress.

title: Jade Biosciences Announces Inducement Grant Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
author: Na
description: Jade Biosciences announced the appointment of Edward R. Conner, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer effective April 22, 2026. As part of the appointment, Dr. Conner received 500,000 non-qualified stock options with an exercise price of $25.38 per share, vesting over four years. The company is a clinical-stage biotech focused on autoimmune disease therapies with lead candidate JADE101 targeting APRIL for immunoglobulin A nephropathy treatment.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The appointment of an experienced Chief Medical Officer (M.D.) signals strengthening of clinical leadership and organizational maturity. The company is progressing with Phase 1 interim data expected in Q2 2026 and Phase 2 trials expected to begin mid-2026, indicating advancement in pipeline development for its lead autoimmune disease candidate.
